_finding: The only key in the project runs here, once a day, unattended. What has to hold: it pays nobody but itself, it refuses a gas price out of line instead of paying it, it never writes a day twice, and it stops rather than guess when an rpc answers for another chain.

mutations.name: the transaction is sent somewhere other than its own address
mutations.find: maxFeePerGas: fees.maxFeePerGas, gasLimit: fees.gasLimit, to: from, value: 0, data,
mutations.replace: maxFeePerGas: fees.maxFeePerGas, gasLimit: fees.gasLimit, to: '0x' + '11'.repeat(20), value: 0, data,
mutations.expect: FAIL it sends exactly the transaction we meant: to itself, value zero, the day and the hash

mutations.name: any gas price is paid
mutations.find: if (worstCaseWei > maxFeeWei) return { send: false, reason: `one write would cost up to ${worstCaseWei} wei, over the cap of ${maxFeeWei}` }
mutations.expect: FAIL a gas price out of line is refused rather than paid

mutations.name: a day already written is written again
mutations.expect: FAIL a day already sent is never sent again, only looked up

mutations.name: an rpc answering for another chain is trusted anyway
mutations.find: if (chainId !== cfg.chainId) throw new Error(`${chain}: the rpc answers for chain ${chainId}, not ${cfg.chainId}`)
mutations.expect: FAIL an rpc answering for another chain stops the write

mutations.name: a transaction the chain has dropped is still called pending
mutations.find: if (inPool === undefined || inPool) return { ...previous, status: previous.status === 'confirmed' ? 'confirmed' : 'pending' }
mutations.expect: FAIL a transaction the chain no longer has is sent again, and the record says which one it replaces

mutations.name: a transaction stuck without a block never raises an alert
mutations.find: const stalePending = m.status === 'pending' && (!Number.isFinite(since) || at - since > STALE_PENDING_MS)
mutations.expect: FAIL a transaction stuck without a block raises an alert too, which nothing else would

mutations.name: whatever the node answers is written down as a transaction hash
mutations.find: if (!TX_HASH_RE.test(String(tx))) throw new Error('the node did not answer with a transaction hash')
mutations.expect: FAIL an answer that is not a transaction hash is refused, so no rpc text can reach a sentence we are quoted on

mutations.name: a day already in a block can be sent again by a node that lost it
mutations.find: if (previous && previous.tx && previous.sha256 === sha256 && Number.isInteger(previous.block) && previous.status !== 'reverted') {
mutations.expect: FAIL a day already in a block is never sent again, whatever a node that lost it says

mutations.name: a chain that says nothing about the base fee is read as free
mutations.find: if (baseFeePerGas == null || BigInt(baseFeePerGas) <= 0n) throw new Error('the chain did not say what the base fee is')
mutations.expect: FAIL a block with no base fee is refused, not read as free

mutations.name: the nonce is taken from the node alone, as it was on the first live run
mutations.find: const nonce = reclaim ? previous.nonce : Math.max(counted, ours)
mutations.expect: FAIL a run counts its own nonces when the node keeps answering the same one

mutations.name: the node's transaction hash is taken on trust
mutations.find: if (String(tx) !== signed.hash) throw new Error(`the node answered a different transaction hash than the one we signed (${String(tx).slice(0, 12)}...)`)
mutations.expect: FAIL a hash that is not the one we signed is refused: we computed it ourselves before sending

mutations.name: one witness alone is taken as a confirmation
mutations.find: else if (agreed.length >= WITNESSES_NEEDED) { out.status = 'confirmed'; out.block = agreed[0].block }
mutations.expect: FAIL one witness alone is not a confirmation, and the record says it agreed but was alone

mutations.name: a witness that sees other bytes at our hash is ignored
mutations.expect: FAIL a source that says the transaction carries something else makes it contradicted, not confirmed

mutations.name: a witness is allowed to be the endpoint we sent to
mutations.expect: FAIL the witnesses of a chain are other operators, and never the endpoint we sent to

mutations.name: a witness need not carry this day and hash
mutations.find: if (read.day !== day || read.sha256 !== sha256) return { source, kind: 'contradicted', why: `it carries ${read.day} ${read.sha256.slice(0, 12)}, not this day and hash` }
mutations.expect: FAIL ...a transaction carrying another day or hash is a contradiction that says what it carries

mutations.name: the word confirmed survives with nobody behind it
mutations.expect: FAIL a day called confirmed with no witness named is asked again, and nothing is sent

mutations.name: a malformed answer from a witness is read as a contradiction
mutations.find: if (!shaped) return { source, kind: 'silent', why: 'answered something that is not a transaction' }
mutations.expect: FAIL a witness answering half a transaction is silent, never a contradiction
